'''Fiev Kyak''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], who was the son of [[Aril Kyak]] and [[Syub Kyak]], and the brother of [[Sien Kyak]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he went on vacation in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] with his family and stayed aboard the space [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] ''[[Crest of Dawn]]''. Along with his sibling, he rewired the navigational controls of the ''Crest'', causing it to get stuck in a radiation storm on [[Genarius]].
